The Web Serial Terminal-style help layout and background scroll locking, including Escape, X, backdrop and mobile short-height operation, are subject to automated testing.

The line centre translates both endpoints together, preserving length and angle; each endpoint adjusts independently.
An empty region of the camera should remain scrollable on mobile; line and handle gestures use isolated touch hit regions.
A successful GitHub Actions run proves the listed automatic checks, not field accuracy.
The three-event synthetic scoring example must never count as human-labeled field evidence.
The repo's model.config.json license declaration alone does not establish a model-specific redistribution grant.
